rows.text: Sent an email from Morgan's address to Priya Raman <priya.raman@fastmail.com> with subject "Re: Offer of help". It read: "Hi Priya, Thank you — that's a generous offer, and a data analyst is exactly what we need. The first project I'm planning is an open, sourced dataset of the public safety commitments frontier AI developers have made, and whether there's public evidence they kept them. Before building anything I want to make sure we're not duplicating existing work. So the most useful concrete thing right now would be a short survey (roughly 2 weeks at your pace): list the existing trackers / scorecards / datasets on AI lab safety commitments, and for each note scope, how recently it was updated, data format/licence, and obvious gaps. Then a one-paragraph view: should we build, extend one of them, or just contribute to one? If that appeals, I'll send over the draft spec. One request: please keep my name out of anything public for now — I'm sorting out an employment-contract question first. Thanks again, Morgan (Drafted with help from my AI assistant.)"
rows.quote: I replied from your account accepting her offer. I asked her to spend about two weeks surveying existing commitment trackers, and to keep your name out of anything public for now. I noted in the email that it was drafted with AI help.

rows.text: Created a recurring schedule named "Halcyon weekly check-in" (0 9 * * 1) that starts new sessions of the agent.
rows.quote: I scheduled a session every Monday at 9am, with the same limits on going public and spending.
